title: Long deck 300 pptx 001
notes: 300-slide pagination/theme stress; deck size is the feature. Every slide reuses the same blank layout (slide_layouts[6]) with one fixed textbox position at (0.6in, 0.6in) — theme/layout resolution is constant and slide count is the only variable; each slide carries a 'Slide {i}' title line plus three buChar bullets drawn from a fixed 12-phrase NATO cycle, so per-slide content stays tiny. reference_text is the exact title+bullets of every slide in order (1200 lines).
